### Xperi Inc. Announces Participation at Investor Conferences


November 5, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/329092987/files/doc_news/Xperi-Inc--Announces-Participation-at-Investor-Conferences-2026.pdf)


**15th Annual Roth Technology Conference in New York on November 18**
**Sidoti Virtual Investor Conference on December 10**


SAN JOSE, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Xperi Inc. (NYSE: XPER) (the “Company” or “Xperi”), an entertainment technology company that invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences, today announced that CEO Jon Kirchner and CFO Robert Andersen will host investor meetings at the 15th Annual Roth Technology Conference in New York City on November 18, 2026, and at the Sidoti Virtual Investor Conference on December 10, 2026.


If you would like to schedule a meeting with Xperi Inc. at these conferences, please reach out to your Roth and Sidoti representatives, or emailIR@xperi.com .


A webcast of the Sidoti Virtual Conference will be available at[Xperi Presentation at Sidoti Virtual Conference.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.xperi.com%2Fevents-and-presentations%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54635692&newsitemid=20261105360642&lan=en-US&anchor=Xperi+Presentation+at+Sidoti+Virtual+Conference.&index=1&md5=e21a70d27d8d19b7a43a9fc19b8fe544)


**About Xperi Inc.**


Xperi invents, develops, and delivers technologies that enable extraordinary experiences. Xperi technologies, delivered via its brands (DTS®, HD Radio™, TiVo®) are integrated into consumer devices and media platforms worldwide, powering smart devices, connected cars and entertainment experiences, including IMAX® Enhanced, a certification and licensing program operated by IMAX Corporation and DTS, Inc. Xperi has created a unified ecosystem that reaches highly engaged consumers, driving increased value for partners, customers and consumers.
